assumptions: The company remains a software and document-orchestration layer and does not take title to feed materials, custody of goods, transport responsibility, laboratory responsibility, or final product-safety liability.
The initial corridor is limited to recurring, separately stored plant-only streams that a registered processor conditionally accepts after stream-specific classification and testing.
The founder can use qualified feed-law and veterinary advisers while keeping routine work within roughly 15 to 25 hours per week and will not use confidential employer information.
The proposed subscription, transaction fee, acquisition cost, renewal rate, and transport-level economics are hypotheses rather than validated facts.
The addressable Polish beachhead consists only of eligible recurring streams that are not already satisfactorily contracted to integrated processors; its size is presently unknown.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: The idea correctly narrows a generic waste marketplace into a stream-specific authorization, evidence, recipient-check, and forward-reservation workflow. That is a real regulatory and coordination problem, but it is still only a hypothesis that the shared record is an independent control point rather than a feature of a processor's integrated service.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: Lawful disposition, traceability, repeat collection, and rejection avoidance are consequential recurring needs for generators and processors. However, the payer is unresolved, no reviewed evidence supports the proposed 500 to 1500 PLN monthly fee or take rate, and many attractive streams may already be served through direct processor relationships; those gaps are uncertainty rather than proof of no demand.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: An asset-light records layer could achieve attractive 65% to 80% contribution margins and start within the stated capital envelope, but its economics depend on excluding the physical work and liability that incumbents use to create value. CAC, sales cycle, retention, stream-level value, and payback are unknown; post-match bypass is structural, and the founder-wealth scenario uses a 4% take rate despite the revised pricing hypothesis of only 1% to 2%.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: One Polish corridor of recurring plant-only streams and pre-accepting registered processors is specific enough for a disciplined beachhead. Industrial activity establishes a real category, but neither the number nor tonnage of eligible, economically transportable, uncontracted streams is known, so the independently serviceable beachhead may be much smaller than the broad food-waste narrative implies.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: IUNGO already sources and processes Polish food-industry streams, while Trotec and FeedValid bundle equipment, weighing, logistics, processing, data, and compliance. These operators own the physical relationship and can add record-keeping, leaving the proposed layer without evidenced exclusive supply, exclusive demand, or another credible route to a dominant corridor position.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: A proven stream record could extend into additional generators, processors, laboratories, forecasts, exception management, and nearby geographies, with prior acceptance data making some adjacencies easier. Expansion is nevertheless constrained by stream-specific rules, local transport economics, and the need to rebuild processor commitments rather than simply switching on a generic marketplace.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: Longitudinal specifications, test results, receiver acceptances, seasonal volumes, and rejection reasons could create workflow switching costs and a useful proprietary dataset. The advantage compounds only if both parties continue recording activity after introduction; direct contracting and incumbent replication can otherwise prevent the dataset from forming.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: The proposed record may improve auditability, recipient checks, forecasting, and recall readiness relative to ad hoc coordination, but no evidence quantifies a material improvement in cost, speed, acceptance rate, or risk. Integrated incumbents already provide data and compliance support alongside the physical services customers ultimately need.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: EU rules provide a lawful route for suitable former food, public registration data enables targeted onboarding, and current Polish processing investment indicates category momentum. The core legal framework is not newly created, however, and investment by integrated processors is simultaneously validation of activity and a competitive threat.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: The official operator register, industry associations, laboratories, and a processor-led corridor provide a finite, testable prospecting route without broad consumer marketing or founder publicity. Repeatable acquisition remains uncertain because the product needs trust on both sides, a processor commitment is a prerequisite, incumbents control existing relationships, and no paid-pilot conversion or sales-cycle evidence exists.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: The software, data, and exception-analysis work fits the founder and a bounded pilot is compatible with the available capital and time if licensed counterparties retain operational duties. Execution still depends on scarce domain judgment, correct platform regulatory status, insurer-approved liability allocation, qualified processor cooperation, and strict avoidance of emergency logistics or safety decisions by a part-time software operator.

main_structural_strength: The stream-bound authorization record can turn recurring classifications, test evidence, recipient eligibility, forecasts, acceptances, and exceptions into a persistent workflow rather than a one-time introduction, while letting licensed operators retain physical handling.
primary_score_limiter: The business has not shown that either party will pay for and repeatedly use a standalone record after matching, while integrated processors already own the operational relationship and can bundle or copy the software layer.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Long-standing and expanding direct operators such as IUNGO, Trotec, and FeedValid already combine sourcing with containers, weighing, processing, logistics, data, and compliance support, indicating that the customer's valued solution is operationally integrated rather than a thin exchange.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid multi-cycle corridor pilot in which one registered processor conditionally commits capacity and at least three generators renew at a stated recurring price, with observed tonnes, transport and testing costs, rejection rates, acquisition effort, gross contribution, record usage after the first match, no bypass, and written regulatory and insurance acceptance of the platform's limited role.
highest_value_structural_change: Replace the two-sided exchange with a processor-anchored intake and compliance operating system: make an independent licensed processor the primary payer and distribution channel, bind generator onboarding to recurring offtake contracts, and secure continued rights to the stream history so revenue and data persist after the first match while physical risk stays with qualified operators.
